title: FFT Waveform Types
description: Interactive simulation showing how different waveform shapes (sine, square, triangle, sawtooth) appear in both time and frequency domains.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Harmonics
Waveforms
learningObjectives: Compare the harmonic spectra of sine, square, triangle, and sawtooth waves at the same fundamental frequency
Explain why square and triangle waves contain only odd harmonics while sawtooth waves contain every integer harmonic
Distinguish the 1/n amplitude decay of a square wave from the 1/n^2 decay of a triangle wave in the spectrum plot
Predict how raising the fundamental frequency slider rescales the position of every harmonic peak
Relate the angularity of a waveform in the time domain to the amount of high-frequency energy in its spectrum
